name: Hyperballin'
summary:
High-octane precision platforming unlike anything you've ever seen. Find the Dominus. Be the fastest. Run through multiple marble racing tracks where the floor is the enemy.

Chain together wall-jumps, floor-surfs, air-dashes, teleports and perfect momentum redirects to increase your speed without limits. One misstep means shattering your Diamond rank.
